summary: Remote-controlled PTY shell driven by WebSocket server
details: When the shipped CLI (bin `yeaft-agent`/`yeaft`, or the systemd/launchd service installed by `service/linux.js`) is started, the agent connects to a WebSocket server configured via `ctx.CONFIG.serverUrl` and dispatches inbound messages to local handlers. The `terminal_create` handler spawns a PTY running the host shell (`bash` on Linux/macOS via `process.env.SHELL`, `powershell`/`cmd` on Windows) and `terminal_input` writes remote message bytes directly into that PTY, giving the remote peer full-host command execution. The same channel exposes file read/write, git push, and an `upgrade_agent` handler that runs `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and relaunches the service via systemd/launchd/PM2, letting the remote peer replace the installed package version at will. `service/linux.js` also modifies `PATH` in the installer's shell configuration to add `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin` for the agent's own binaries.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
